amends.scope_change: the stale-hold 'no exit execution while STALE' remains for ordinary exits but no longer blocks risk reductions that pass alternative independent price verification

principles_all_options: no PAPER fill of any kind from an unverified price
if a required risk reduction cannot execute, status = '위험 평가·집행 불확실' shown on portal chapter 04 with symbol, reason, start time, elapsed
P&L during the gap recorded from the first fresh price, never interpolated
market-blocked execution (limit-down lock, halt, VI single-price) labelled '집행 불가(시장)' separately
decision.ordinary_exits: strength release, time exit, drift: hold while STALE (option A behavior)
decision.risk_reductions: STRESS, disaster stop, drawdown override, regime downgrade reduction: first try alternative independent price verification (crypto: path independent of the public WebSocket passing provider age <=20s, transport <=3s and content checks; KR/US: KIS quote or another path passing section 3 quote-age limits; other-exchange prices only for outlier checks, never as fill price)
decision.if_no_alternative_price: mark '위험 평가·집행 불확실' and execute immediately at the symbol's first FRESH price without waiting for the next decision slot
decision.record: delay loss (decision-time vs fill price) recorded separately for the scorecard

implementation_notes: alternative price path must be implemented and verified before it can be used; until then behavior is effectively A + immediate first-fresh execution
